Chapter Eighteen: Enduring Relevance—The Apostles in Today’s World
Even after all these centuries, the big questions the apostles faced? They’re still with us. How do you live with real purpose? How do we build communities that truly welcome and heal? And how do you find hope when life feels like a struggle?
The apostles didn’t always have tidy answers. They doubted, they failed, they felt afraid—just like we do. But here’s what’s amazing: they kept showing up. They kept loving, and they never stopped believing that change was possible.
Their stories invite us to do the same. To find something sacred in everyday moments. To open our hearts to outsiders. To forgive, and to start over when we need to. Even a tiny act of kindness? It can ripple outwards, changing lives in ways you might never even know.
Most of us don’t realize how powerful our own story can be. But the apostles remind us: every single life matters. Greatness isn’t about being perfect. It’s about sticking with it, no matter what.
If you’re searching for meaning, their example is a gentle push forward. The path ahead might not always be clear, but trust me—it’s worth walking.
